description: A modular workbench for building deterministic, repeatable workflows that have models in them — agents, wiring, context, gears and pipelines, set by hand or by the orchestrator. Local-first, no telemetry.
_comment: Canonical manifest lives in https://github.com/orkcom-tech/scoop-bucket — this copy is the template scripts/ci/publish-packages.sh fills. `depends` is Contextverse: context and memory are stored by contextd, and Scoop can express that, so it does.
notes: Gears and the terminal need Docker Desktop to be isolated. Without it, gears run with this server's own file access and the terminal refuses to open.
